106: ## Python typing and stub files
108: To provide best experience, Pyright requires packages to be type annotated
109: and/or have stub files. The Python community is currently in a transition phase
110: where package authors are actively looking to provide that. Meanwhile, stub
111: files for well-known packages may also be obtained from 3rd party, for example:
113: - [Awesome Python Typing # stub-packages](https://github.com/typeddjango/awesome-python-typing#stub-packages)
114: - [typeshed](https://github.com/python/typeshed)
115: - [python-type-stubs](https://github.com/microsoft/python-type-stubs)
